'''Chapter 554''' is titled "Admiral Akainu".

==Cover Page==
[[Straw Hat's Separation Serial]]: [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]]'s 'I'm not food, Dammit' Final Volume: Birds and Human in battle.

==Short Summary==
[[Polo Marco|Marco]] takes [[Admiral]] [[Borsalino|Kizaru]]'s attacks head on. The [[Giant Squad]] start advancing but are stopped by [[Jozu]]. Admiral [[Sakazuki|Akainu]] sends a volley of volcanic projectiles crashing down onto the advancing pirates, sinking one of Whitebeard's ships; however, Whitebeard defends the [[Moby Dick]]. The war rages on between the Marines and pirates. [[Little Oars Jr.]] then appears at Marineford.

==Long Summary==
The [[Marines]] are still shocked that [[Polo Marco|Marco]] took an attack from [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] and is still standing. They all talk about the rumors of Marco's ability. Kizaru comments on the "Mythical Beast" [[Zoan]], saying it was scarier than a [[Logia]] as Marco takes on the form of a [[Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Phoenix|phoenix]]. Marco hurtles towards Kizaru in his Zoan form and turns into the common hybrid form for a Zoan, half animal and human. He kicks Kizaru, sending the Admiral crashing to the ground. Kizaru seems unharmed and orders the [[Giant Squad]] to prepare for air assaults. The group of Marine [[giants]] prepare themselves, heading towards the [[Whitebeard Pirates]].

The pirates of Whitebeard prepare themselves for the "big boys", telling everyone to stand back. [[Jozu]] appears to lift something and turns out to be a gigantic piece of an iceberg, big enough to easily cover the Giant Squad of the Marines. [[Sakazuki|Akainu]] admonishes all the Marines for not being able to protect [[Marineford]]. Akainu then uses a [[Magu Magu no Mi|magma fist]] to evaporate the entire iceberg and also sends magma projectiles towards the [[Whitebeard Pirates]].

[[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]] still stands on the whale head of his [[Moby Dick|ship]], watching as the projectiles destroy one of his ships. Whitebeard mutters, saying that Akainu thought he was "cool" with his fire. Whitebeard catches a flaming rock from Akainu, catching it on [[Murakumogiri|his naginata]]. He tells Akainu to go light a birthday cake, which the Marine admiral retorts that he would like to light Whitebeard's funeral pyre. Battle rages throughout the bay: two Whitebeard Pirates take on a Marine giant, while a man holding a flaming [[katana]] attacks a group of Marines.

During this fighting, the descendant of [[Oars]], [[Little Oars Jr.]] arrives, looming over Marineford. [[Gecko Moria]] crackles, surprised that Oars' descendant was under Whitebeard's command and that he wanted to claim his corpse. [[Donquixote Doflamingo]] also laughs, saying that things have just turned interesting.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*Chopper manages to elude the natives while they fight against the giant birds.
*[[Polo Marco|Marco]]'s [[Devil Fruit]] power is shown to be the mythical beast, the [[Tori Tori no Mi, Model: Phoenix|Phoenix]].
*[[Sakazuki|Akainu]]'s face is properly shown.
*[[Onigumo]] is seen from the behind with spider features, indicating Devil Fruit powers.
*Akainu is shown to have a [[Magu Magu no Mi|Devil Fruit power relating to magma]].
*Little Oars Jr., a descendant of Oars, is introduced.

==Trivia==
*This chapter and [[Chapter 646]] has the second most double pages with seven, after [[Chapter 553]] and [[Chapter 555|555]] with eight.
**Excluding the title page, this is the only chapter in the entire manga so far to only have double pages.
*Along with its [[Weekly Shonen Jump|magazine release]] was also [[Grand Line Times]].
